entry.author: Open Polytechnic
entry.summary:
Do you know that Open Polytechnic has been helping Kiwis get access to flexible learning no matter where they are for 80 years? 

Open Polytechnic graduate Samantha Bradford thinks that 80 years of helping New Zealanders gain education and skills to better their future is wonderful. 

“Many more years to come and many more people to find careers and employment thanks to Open Polytechnic,” she exclaims.  

Samantha can’t wait to see what the future holds for her career and Open Polytechnic.
